import asyncio,contextlib,io,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from scripts.qwen import coding_worker as cli
O=Path(__file__).parent
v=json.loads((O/'probe-results.json').read_text());rows={x['case']:x for x in v['rows']}
assert len(rows)==16
for name in ['prepared-success','native-repair','native-shared-success','map-exact-chain','directory-reuse']:
 r=rows[name];assert r['result']['accepted'] and r['result']['disposition']=='ACCEPTED' and r['result']['source_restored'] and r['current_source']=='def value():\n    return 0\n'
assert rows['native-repair']['result']['repair_cycles']==1 and rows['native-repair']['model_entries']==3
assert 'must return one' in ''.join(rows['native-repair']['feedback'])
for name in ['unobserved','foreign','map-chain']:
 assert not rows[name]['result']['accepted'] and rows[name]['apply_effects']==[]
assert rows['foreign']['model_entries']==1 and rows['foreign']['result']['context_actions_attempted']==0
for name in ['cancel-model','provider-failure']:
 r=rows[name];assert r['model_entries']==1 and all(x is None for x in r['result']['usage_totals'].values())
assert rows['cancel-model']['result']['disposition']=='CANCELLED_COMPLETION_UNKNOWN_NO_RETRY'
assert rows['unknown-source']['current_source']=='UNKNOWN AUDIT BYTES\n' and not rows['unknown-source']['result']['source_restored']
assert rows['post-apply-failure']['model_entries']==1 and len(rows['post-apply-failure']['apply_effects'])==1 and rows['post-apply-failure']['result']['source_restored']
assert rows['result-write-failure']['exception']['type']=='OSError' and not rows['result-write-failure']['result_file'] and rows['result-write-failure']['current_source']=='def value():\n    return 0\n'
bad=rows['post-accept-stage-failure'];assert bad['result']['accepted'] and bad['result']['disposition']=='CONTEXT_TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED' and len(bad['apply_effects'])==1 and bad['model_entries']==3
assert bad['result']['change_check']['ready_for_review'] and bad['result']['change_check_freshness']['current']
assert rows['post-command-result-failure']['command_effects'][0]['exit_code']==0 and rows['post-command-result-failure']['result']['turns'][0]['context_tools'][0]['status']=='REFUSED'
assert rows['cancel-validation']['exception']['type']=='CancelledError' and rows['cancel-validation']['result']['disposition']=='HOST_CANCELLED' and rows['cancel-validation']['result']['source_restored']
assert rows['directory-reuse']['second_entry_refused'] and rows['directory-reuse']['model_entries_after_reuse']==1
async def returned(*args,**kwargs):return bad['result']
with patch.object(cli,'run_local_task',returned),patch.object(sys,'argv',['worker','--report-directory',str((O/'never-created-cli-result').resolve())]),contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
 code=asyncio.run(cli.main())
